rawContent: I'm not sure if it, for him, means amplifying the voices of those who are survivors and participate in the #MeToo movement. If it means that he'll also address and/or stop working w/ the men he mentioned during his speech.

His work has depended on believing in "not being a victim, but a victor" as if survivors have control over all things that have happened to them. That isn't something u can believe in if ur truly for the #MeToo movement bc it requires placing the responsibility on the abusers.
